name: update_lead
description: Save details the visitor just shared so Ahmed can follow up. Call it every time you learn something new. Send only the fields you just learned.

email.description: Visitor's email address, exactly as they spelled it.

phone.description: Phone number, only if the visitor offers it.

interest.description: What they want from Ahmed, in one sentence: the role they are hiring for, or the project they need built.

timeline.description: When they need someone or want to start.

budget.description: Budget or salary range, only if they mention it.

location.description: Where the role or client is based, or remote.

notes.description: Anything else useful for Ahmed, including questions you could not answer.

name: show_booking
description: Open Ahmed's calendar next to the chat so the visitor can book a call. Use it after you have their name and email and they want to talk to Ahmed.

name: show_project
description: Show the visitor a card for one of Ahmed's projects while you talk about it.

project.description: One of: kipo, wheretospot, onething, rafiq, medilink, grevo, kitchentrace, wafa.
